metadata.title: Global Media Flows and Cultural Imperialism
Global Media Flows and Cultural Imperialism

sections.text: Global media studies examines how media products, formats, and industries cross national borders -- and what that means for culture, power, and identity. The central debate pits cultural imperialism (Western, especially US, media dominates and homogenizes world culture) against counter-arguments emphasizing local resistance, adaptation, and the emergence of multiple media power centers.
